name: PaperPlanes — Stratified Scene Reconstruction
author: HereLiesAz
description: Turn a flat image or painting into coherent depth-ordered paper-theater layers using perspective normalization, semantic segmentation, depth fusion, occlusion reasoning, hidden-surface completion, adaptive plane allocation, and composite QC.

definitions.name: PaperPlanes — Stratified Scene Reconstruction
definitions.description: Decompose a single image into production-ready layered planes while preserving source composition and explicit occlusion order.

agents.name: PaperPlanes Scene Director
agents.description: Owns source fidelity, intent, constraints, and final deliverable coherence.

agents.name: PaperPlanes Geometry Engineer
agents.description: Builds depth, segmentation, confidence, and plane-allocation evidence.

agents.name: PaperPlanes Occlusion Architect
agents.description: Resolves front/back topology, overlapping objects, and hidden surfaces.

agents.name: PaperPlanes Layer Engineer
agents.description: Synthesizes clean RGBA strata, cut geometry, bleed, registration, and packaging artifacts.

agents.name: PaperPlanes Visual QC
agents.description: Attempts to falsify layer fidelity with composite and parallax checks.
